name: agent-native
description: Open and operate granted Agent-Native apps through Dispatch MCP, with inline app surfaces and current browser screen state.

interface.shortDescription: Open and operate granted Agent-Native apps through Dispatch MCP, with inline app surfaces and current browser screen state.
interface.longDescription: Agent-Native packages agent instructions, app actions, an MCP connector, and inline UI surfaces as an installable skill. The plugin connects to hosted Agent-Native by default; use the Agent-Native CLI when you need a custom/self-hosted app URL.
defaultPrompt: Search Agent-Native and return usable context
